demo.role: local terminal tic-tac-toe demo; human is X and Crystal-9 is O
demo.input: one unoccupied a-i square per turn
demo.board: three plain rows using ., x, and o

boundaries: The packed artifacts are custom Python-runtime containers, not Transformers checkpoints, GGUF, llama.cpp, or Ollama models. Users needing GGUF or standard llama.cpp/Ollama compatibility should use Palace-9: https://huggingface.co/lewismoten/palace-9.
The FP16-scale variant is an INT4-code artifact with FP16 dequantization scales; it is not a full-FP16 model.

exclusions.full_fp16_model: not created or accepted for Crystal-9
exclusions.int3: ongoing staged research; no accepted full packed runtime or release artifact
exclusions.browser_projection: separate derivative representation; not needed for Python runtime
exclusions.tensor_inspectors: decoded non-reconstructable visualizations; assets/int4-full-qat-tensor-workflow.png documents the QAT tensor workflow only

publication_blockers: hosted repository target and external upload approval
